title: A library skill's SKILL.md front matter (skills/<name>/SKILL.md, 7.56.00)
description: The skills library: guidance a role reads on demand (read_skill), listed in its system prompt by name and description. name is the skill's directory; source says where it came from (a vendored skill keeps its upstream's attribution, and THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.md names that upstream with its licence), license its licence, adapted what changed from the source. The body is free Markdown; a skill's other files are references/<file>.md.

description.description: One line: what the skill is for and when to read it (the system prompt lists it).

source.description: Where it came from: '<package> <version> (<author>), <path>' for a vendored skill.

license.description: The licence it is used under (SPDX).

adapted.description: What changed from the source, in one line.
